id: title:ablaszkiewicz:match pasted issue ids in quick search

review.posthog_relevance: Adds UUID and UUID7 support to HogQL error tracking query execution and issue ID matching, enabling the HogQL engine to correctly identify and correlate issues using these identifiers.
review.reason: The change introduces UUID and UUID7 support into HogQL execution and issue ID matching. P1.F1.H1 adds the UUID import and parsing helper, P1.F1.H3 uses UUID in an OR expression for issue ID matching, and P1.F2.H1 adds UUID7 and its associated test setup. review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of a production use case for UUID/UUID7 issue IDs, which is not independently verified in the provided observations. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of the capability, not on demonstrated adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No untrusted instructions. No score assigned yet.
